cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.
